command: Connect the verified M->SFU, SFU->M, M->KV and KV->M skid channels to production Matrix/SFU/KV wrapper endpoints. Compose them with the 4-to-2R/2-to-1W arbiter and queued real-SRAM event frontend, then run at least 100000 integrated command/event/descriptor/DMA/stream transactions. Bind all builds/tests to CPU 8-25 and start only above 10 GiB MemAvailable.
success_condition: 100000+ combined transactions have zero loss, duplication, reorder, starvation, assertion, macro error or timeout; command completion cannot precede final stream acceptance, event zero/error semantics hold, all clients and all four direct channels make progress, and L3 can close.
failure_policy: Do not statically reserve one physical read port for descriptors, add a third physical read port, bypass the real SRAM scoreboard, hide timeout, weaken fairness, or mark L3 PASS from standalone readiness tests.
